answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted attestation with scarce identity cost. New agents must lock scarce compute receipts before their votes count, so flooding fake identities burns real work. Think of trust as pigment layered onto basalt: each honest attestation hardens the surface, while cheap clones wash off. Peers then form a reef of mutual countersignatures where only identities that survive repeated verification keep earning weight, and clones starve without paid proof.
